industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Agricultural Food & other Products > Sugar

operating_notes.text: Agreed to sell Meerganj sugar unit via slump sale for up to ₹305 Cr.
Wholly owned subsidiary DBOL International Food and Beverages Trading FZE incorporated in JAFZA, Dubai, for trading, distribution and packaging of sugar and other FMCG products.
Signed JV agreement with Orgonew Private Limited; Dhampur Bio to hold 74% and Orgonew 26% of the JVC, with Orgonew's stake maintained at 26% for the first three years and a 5-year lock-in.

Executed a 10-year Technology Licensing Agreement with Planetary SA, Switzerland for exclusive Mycoprotein production in India, paying 10% of after-tax revenue as royalty plus one-time launch and IT setup fees.

timeline.summary: Dhampur Bio Organics agreed to sell its Meerganj sugar unit for ₹305 Cr and form a 74% JV with Orgonew on April 20, 2026.

On May 13, 2026, Dhampur Bio Organics said its wholly owned subsidiary DBOL International Food and Beverages Trading FZE was incorporated in Dubai's JAFZA for sugar and FMCG trading, following its February 26 intimation.
Dhampur Bio Organics held its EGM on May 18, 2026, where shareholders approved the slump sale of the Meerganj sugar unit and board changes.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹773.59 Cr (+10.1% YoY), net profit ₹46.27 Cr (+3.3% YoY).
Dhampur Bio Organics reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹552.44 Cr (+19% YoY) and PAT of ₹46 Cr.
Mr. Gautam Goel, on behalf of promoters and persons acting in concert, declared no encumbrance of Dhampur Bio Organics Ltd. shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).

On June 4, 2026, Dhampur Bio Organics signed a Joint Venture Agreement with Orgonew Private Limited to make and sell phyto bio-active functional foods such as curcumin-coated low-GI sugar, with Dhampur Bio holding 74% and Orgonew 26% of the JVC.
On October 19, 2026, Dhampur Bio Organics executed a Technology Licensing Agreement with Planetary SA, Switzerland for exclusive Mycoprotein production in India.
